item.title: Berlinan 1.2.9
item.description:
• Fixed: after picking EXT or LINK, the clock-source label in the transport bar kept showing INT (the choice itself did take effect).
  • The clock-source tooltip no longer gives a setup for Ableton Live that cannot work; it now points to an IAC bus.
  • Manual and website reviewed for beginners: plainer wording, no made-up terms, factual fixes (English and Czech).
